description: AT-26 Xavante FAB 4472, trucked from the Recife depot and mounted at the city's request in 2012 (O Diário). Toppled by 40 km/h winds in 2026; restoration with private sponsorship and FAB support began 22-24 Aug 2026, with replica gun pods planned (Maringá Post, Sociedade Militar). Expected back on its pylon.
aliases: AT26; Xavante; EMB-326GB; EMB326GB; MB-326GC; MB326GC; MB-326; MB326
